item.title: Managing AI Coding Costs at Scale
Article: Comprehension as an Architectural Characteristic: A System That Is Not Understood Cannot Evolve Safely
item.description: As AI commoditizes code output, system comprehension silently decays, creating cognitive debt that threatens safe architectural evolution. (1 source: infoq)
